_readme: Mat khau phu (secondary passphrase) cho tung giam khao. Sua gia tri 'passphrase' roi luu file - server doc lai moi lan login, khong can rebuild. 'tidecloakPassword' la mat khau cua user trong realm TideCloak (mac dinh 'password' theo blindvault-realm.json) - giam khao KHONG nhap mat khau nay, server tu dung sau khi mat khau phu dung.
